name: Rive Web
role: Plays Rive .riv interactive animations with state machines; authoring is in the Rive app
summary: Web runtime for Rive files authored in the Rive editor, offered as canvas and WebGL builds over a WASM core. Plays named animations and state machines with inputs set from code, so interactive characters and UI can be driven programmatically. It is a playback runtime: assets cannot be authored through this API. Distinguishing strength: runtime state machines in a small binary format.
use_when: A designer ships a .riv with state machines or inputs to drive from data
Over Lottie when the asset needs interactive state, not a linear loop
Interactive mascots and animated UI controls
avoid_when: Source is After Effects: Lottie Web
Linear exported loops with a tiny player: dotLottie
Generating animation from code: GSAP, Anime.js or Motion Canvas
license: MIT runtime (@rive-app/canvas); authoring in the proprietary Rive app, free and paid plans
notes: 2026-10-26: frame-exact seeking for capture not verified; the runtime is clocked by requestAnimationFrame.

assessment.rationale: Active: 2.47.1 released 2026-10-24, MIT runtime. Only route for .riv assets; playback-only, authoring needs the Rive app.
